<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087042026-02-2316-58-53" status="finalized"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs gter</rs> gyi gzhung <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b4"/>
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs> las rang rigs 'phen pa 4 dang ¦ gzhan rigs 'phen pa bcu <expan>bzhir</expan> bshad la ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs> las rang rigs 'phen pa lnga gzhan rigs 'phen pa <expan>bcu drug</expan> tu bshad pa'i don <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6828"><expan>slob dpon</expan> phyogs glang gsar ma byaMs pa mgon po</rs>s bshad pa ltar na ¦
   <lg>  <l>me dang ba mo spu long dang ||</l>
         <l>ba mo'i spu long ltos bcas kyis ||</l>
         <l>grang reg tsan me du ba dang ¦||</l>
         <l>tsan du nges pa <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b5"/> rim pa <expan>bzhin</expan> ||</l>
         <l>'gog pa'i rang rigs 'phen pa lnga ||</l>
         <l>'di yang dpyad par bya ba yin |</l></lg> lnga po de la ba mo'i spu long gis <expan>tsan dan</expan> gyi du ba 'gog pa mi 'thad la ¦ ltos pas nges pa 'gog pa'ang bcu 2 po'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir ¦ 3 mam phan tshun 2 ka rtsis na drug <expan>yin no</expan> ||
       <lg>  <l>yang gzhan rigs 'phen pa'ang ¦</l>
         <l>me dang du bas ma reg <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b6"/> dang ||</l>
         <l>me dang grang bas spu long dud ||</l>
         <l>shing dang me med shab du med ||</l>
         <l>spu long bye brag yod me med ||</l>
         <l>sha ba shing du thal ba ste ||</l></lg>
         bzlog pas <expan>bcu drug</expan> gzhan rigs 'phen zhes bya ste | de la dang po me ba reg dang ¦ du bas ma reg 'gog pa 2 rung la | mes spu long 'gog <choice><sic>pang</sic><corr>pa'ang</corr></choice> grang pas dud pa 'gog pa 2 gnad 1 pas gang rung 1 mi <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="59b7"/>'thad cing | shing med pas shab med 'phen pa dang bzhi ¦ sha pas shing du thal ba 'phen pa dang lnga du ba yod pas me yod par thal ba dang drug | me <expan>med</expan>  pas du med du thal ba 'phen pa dang bdun po phan tshun bzlog pas bcu <expan>bzhir</expan> 'gyur gyi spu long gi bye <expan>brag gis</expan> me 'gog pa'ang mi rig te | sngar rang rgyud kyi <expan>rtags</expan> kyi grangs nges bstan pa des shes par nus pa <pb edRef="inst:5293" n="60a"/><lb edRef="inst:5293" n="60a1"/> <expan>yin no</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
